mentions.name: Earcast
mentions.description: A browser extension that turns any web article into a text-to-speech narration on demand, producing a custom podcast RSS URL that works in almost any podcast player. It reads page content only when activated using least-privilege content-script APIs, and supports typical podcast controls like speed settings and skipping, so users can catch up on articles while driving or walking without new apps or extra screen time.
mentions.problem: Text-to-speech quality used to be too robotic to listen to for long; the builder wanted to keep up with long-form articles while reducing screen time.
mentions.audience: Text-to-speech quality used to be too robotic to listen to for long; the builder wanted to keep up with long-form articles while reducing screen time.
mentions.source_excerpt: There's a browser extension that reads the content of the article on the page (only when you activate it, using least privilege browser APIs for content scripts) and then narrates the article for you. You get a custom podcast RSS URL that works in (almost) any podcast player, and then you can take articles with you to catch up while driving, walking the dog, etc.
